# harborpilot_service_principal_token (Ephemeral Resource)

Issues a control-plane API token (`hpa_…`) for a service principal while Terraform runs and, by default, revokes it afterwards. Requires Terraform 1.10 or later. The token is never stored in state or plan files; pass it to another provider or a write-only argument.

A token carries its service principal's permissions (for example `usage.read` for `GET /api/v1/budgets/status`, `config.read`, `activity.read`); grant them on `harborpilot_service_principal`. Terraform opens an ephemeral resource on every plan and apply, so each run issues a new token; with `revoke_on_close = false` earlier tokens stay valid until `ttl_seconds` passes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An orchestrator's read-only identity. Its API token carries these
# permissions; usage.read covers GET /api/v1/budgets/status.
resource "harborpilot_service_principal" "orchestrator" {
  name        = "orchestrator"
  permissions = ["config.read", "usage.read", "activity.read"]
}

# Issue the token during the run and hand it to another provider's
# write-only argument. revoke_on_close = false keeps it valid for 30 days
# after Terraform finishes; omit it to revoke the token when the run ends.
ephemeral "harborpilot_service_principal_token" "orchestrator" {
  service_principal_id = harborpilot_service_principal.orchestrator.id
  name                 = "orchestrator"
  ttl_seconds          = 30 * 24 * 3600
  revoke_on_close      = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_principal_id` (String) Service principal id.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Label (default `terraform-ephemeral`).
- `revoke_on_close` (Boolean) Revoke the token when Terraform closes the ephemeral resource (default `true`). Set to `false` to keep it valid until `ttl_seconds` passes, for a token another system keeps.
- `ttl_seconds` (Number) Lifetime in seconds (default 3600, at most 63072000, two years).

### Read-Only

- `expires_at` (String)
- `permissions` (Set of String) Permissions the token carries (the service principal's).
- `prefix` (String)
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The bearer token.
- `token_id` (String)
